pages.title: Accordion
pages.description: Sections that open and close, built on <details> : also without JavaScript, from the keyboard and with screen readers.

sections.title: With a label and inside a card

pages.title: Buttons
pages.description: Buttons of all kinds and sizes. A .kit-btn works on <button> , <a> and <label> .

pages.title: Cards and details
pages.description: Cards, KPI cards, stats row, lists, key/value pairs and code blocks: the containers and details of a dashboard.

pages.title: Charts
pages.description: Bars, lines, donut and sparklines in SVG, no libraries. They require kit.js .

pages.title: Dates and times
pages.description: Date and time fields with the kit's look, an optional calendar for a date, a range, date and time, and time only. Designed for the phone: on narrow screens the calendar slides up from the bottom, with 44-pixel targets.

pages.title: Alerts and progress
pages.description: Alerts, status badges, progress bars, empty states and a welcome screen.

pages.title: Forms: select and file
pages.description: Custom select, file field, drop zone and combobox: the controls that need kit.js .

pages.title: Forms: layout and validation
pages.description: Labels, help text, required fields, column, grid, horizontal and sectioned forms, valid and invalid states with messages, automatic validation, sizes, icons inside fields, field groups, floating labels, card-style checkboxes and the other controls.

pages.title: Forms: basic fields
pages.description: Text field, search, checkbox and switch. Buttons and fields have the same height ( --kit-ctl ), so they sit well on the same row.

pages.title: Grid
pages.description: A 12-column flexbox grid, with the same names as Bootstrap. It is built with rows and columns and changes as the screen width changes.

pages.title: Icons
pages.description: The kit's icons: an SVG sprite you include with one line of JavaScript.

pages.title: Introduction
pages.description: Dashboard Kit is a small CSS framework, with optional JavaScript, for building dashboards. A single file, no dependencies, light and dark themes, and a 12-column grid like Bootstrap.

pages.title: JavaScript
pages.description: JavaScript is optional. Without kit.js all the styling works; you only need it for the parts that move: theme, tabs, select, menus, dialogs and toasts.

pages.title: Layout
pages.description: Container, fixed header, element bars, stacking and side panel: the structure of a page. For columns see the grid .

pages.title: Navbar
pages.description: The top bar with logo, items, dropdown menus, actions and a collapsible menu on small screens.

pages.title: Tabs and breadcrumb
pages.description: Tabs, segmented control, pills, chips and breadcrumb: ways to choose what to show, to filter and to find your way.

pages.title: Dialogs and menus
pages.description: Dialog windows, pop-up menus and temporary messages. They require kit.js .

pages.title: Sidebar
pages.description: The navigation bar on the left, with header, items, sub-items, account and utilities at the bottom. Slide-in on small screens, compact (icons only) on large ones.

sections.title: Account and utilities at the bottom

pages.title: VS Code snippets
pages.description: Type the prefix and press Tab: the editor writes the component's markup, with the fields to fill in.

pages.title: Tables
pages.description: Compact tables with a sticky header, selectable rows and aligned numbers.

pages.title: Themes and tokens
pages.description: The whole look comes from a few CSS variables. Changing them in :root , or on a single element, changes colors, density and corners of the whole interface.

pages.title: Typography
pages.description: Headings, body text, quotes, lists and the classes to control size, weight, line height and line width. It all starts from a few tokens, so it is adjusted from a single place.

pages.title: Utilities
pages.description: One-line classes, as in Bootstrap: spacing, display, flexbox, sizes, text and visibility. Almost all use !important to win over components.
